resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Bengali source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bengali pass identified 25 actionable terminology, formula, punctuation, and unit defects across circuit, thermal, trigonometric, SI, and wire-gauge content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Bengali human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The electrical-power title used the Bengali word for energy rather than power.
evidence: The previous title was ‘বৈদ্যুতিক শক্তি’ although the section defines P in watts.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘বৈদ্যুতিক ক্ষমতা’.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff display name used an English possessive construction.
evidence: The previous display name used ‘Kirchhoff এর আইন’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Bengali possessive ‘কির্শহফের সূত্রসমূহ’.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description used an awkward literal conservation construction.
evidence: The previous text did not clearly identify node-current and loop-voltage conservation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the description with precise circuit terminology.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms title was a literal translation of terms and sounded unnatural.
evidence: The previous title was ‘সার্কিট শর্তাবলী’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘সার্কিটের পরিভাষা’.

findings.summary: The series-resistance formula contained corrupted Bengali variable text.
evidence: The previous formula used ‘আর_মোট’.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected R_total notation.

findings.summary: The series-resistance example formula localized its variable and decimal value.
evidence: The previous expression used Bengali variable text and Bengali numerals.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘R_total = 0.40 Ω’.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used an incorrect word for algebraic signs.
evidence: The previous wording described changing ‘লক্ষণ’ rather than mathematical signs.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph using চিহ্ন and consistent polarity terminology.

findings.summary: The coefficient-sign bullet was grammatically incomplete.
evidence: The previous sentence began ‘সহগ বিষয়ের চিহ্ন’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the sentence explaining reversal caused by replacing a negative value with its absolute value.

findings.summary: The TCR power paragraph mixed resistance capacity with electrical power terminology.
evidence: The previous text repeatedly used প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা for resistance and শক্তি for power.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with রোধ, কারেন্ট, and ক্ষমতা.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation was awkward and used unclear ratio wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph described sides as being ‘across’ and omitted clear ratio notation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with Bengali explanations and explicit SOH-CAH-TOA ratios.

findings.summary: The cosine formula omitted spacing and used a localized label inconsistent with the contract.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘cos(θ) = সংলগ্ন/কর্ণ’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘cos(θ) = adjacent / hypotenuse’.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula mixed Bengali labels with an inconsistent protected expression.
evidence: The previous expression used localized text inside the inverse function formula.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘θ = sin^-1(opposite / hypotenuse)’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity display name was too literal and ambiguous with thermal power.
evidence: The previous display name was ‘তাপ ক্ষমতা’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘তাপধারণ ক্ষমতা’.

findings.summary: The object-and-material paragraph used an unnatural material-property phrase.
evidence: The previous text ended ‘একটি উপাদান সম্পত্তি.’ and mixed object terminology.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with পদার্থের বৈশিষ্ট্য and consistent তাপধারণ ক্ষমতা.

findings.summary: The heat-loss limitations paragraph used a literal and awkward real-versus-ideal construction.
evidence: The previous sentence said a real result could ‘make’ different from the ideal.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as causes that make the real result differ from the ideal.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference bullet used a literal phrase for equal size.
evidence: The previous bullet ended ‘সমান আকার’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Bengali statement that the differences are equal.

findings.summary: The heat-flux formula omitted spaces around the division operator.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘q'' = Q_dot/A’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘q'' = Q_dot / A’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux worked-example title was a literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘কাজের উদাহরণ’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘সমাধানসহ উদাহরণ’.

findings.summary: The practical-checks title used a loanword that sounded like a software check.
evidence: The previous title was ‘ব্যবহারিক চেক’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘ব্যবহারিক পরীক্ষা’.

findings.summary: The local-peak check used an unnatural phrase for distinguishing average and peak flow.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘স্থানীয় শিখর থেকে ... পার্থক্য করুন’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as distinguishing average heat flow from a local maximum.

findings.summary: The final heat-flux check used an ambiguous reference to heat capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used তাপ ক্ষমতা after the display name was corrected.
findings.resolution: Changed it to তাপধারণ ক্ষমতা and clarified heat flux as a transfer rate.

findings.summary: The SI table mistranslated mole and candela.
evidence: The previous rows used আঁচিল for mole and left candela in English.
findings.resolution: Corrected the rows to মোল/mol and ক্যান্ডেলা/cd.

findings.summary: The SI watt bullet labeled power as energy.
evidence: The previous bullet was ‘শক্তি: ওয়াট’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘ক্ষমতা: ওয়াট’.

findings.summary: The AWG paragraph mistranslated current-carrying capacity as breadth.
evidence: The previous text used প্রশস্ততা for ampacity.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with কারেন্ট বহন ক্ষমতা and natural installation terminology.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance paragraph used an unnatural phrase for a moderate diameter difference.
evidence: The previous text used শালীন ব্যাসের পার্থক্য.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a সামান্য ব্যাসের পার্থক্য and clarified the AWG relationship.
